name: qiaomu-opencli-skills
title_zh: 用命令行逛遍全网内容社区
tagline_zh: B站、知乎、X、YouTube、微博、小红书、V2EX、Reddit……不用开浏览器，终端里一条命令拉取、搜索。
tagline_en: Bilibili, Zhihu, X, YouTube, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, V2EX, Reddit — browse, search, and post from your terminal. No.
desc_en: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit,
why_zh: 把各家网站的私有接口统一收敛成一套 opencli 子命令，脚本化、可管道、可定时。
why_en: It normalizes each site's private API into one opencli command set — scriptable, pipeable, schedulable. Content consumption.
limit_zh: 只覆盖列出的八个站点，且依赖 opencli 已登录对应账号；不支持私信、直播、付费内容；发布仅限文本。
limit_en: Only the 8 listed sites; requires opencli logged into each. No DMs, livestreams, or paywalled content. Publishing is text-only; media needs official.
